title: Hash#key, slice and slice! carry a pair out of a hash in a C local only; it is collected and then answered
live_proof: upstream fixed it in fb4974528 (fb4974528a10b388d3eeec678da612ab59820d71) (2026-09-12), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: heap-buffer-overflow (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: heap-use-after-free); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict.
